race.comment: ROCK FEST (10) returned with a bang before repeating the dose as a $1.60 pop last start. Getting to this race has always been the plan and while he's winning at a lower level, his figures stack up in a race like this. Well placed from the barrier here and can win his way into the Railway. WESTERN MISS (12) came from nowhere to get the bob last start at the mile here in an eye-catching performance. Pike now hops on board and she's drawn to stalk ROCK FEST all the way around. She looks the main danger. MEMORY PARADE (9) backs up quickly after a 1L defeat over 1800m last start in the Luckygray. Back to the mile may hold the key and she's sure to get her chance from the inside barrier. AWESOME BOY (6) can tend to dip second-up, but usually bounces back at his next run. His fresh effort was huge and that's the run worth assessing him on. ZIPAWAY (1) looks in great form and can be flying from the rear of the field.
